text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein calls for "support of Palestinians to help in implementing (Israeli-Palestinian) peace accords", says that "permanent Middle East peace will only be consolidated with justice."

- Prime Minister Kabariti, during a news conference with Palestinian leader Arafat in self-rule Jericho enclave, says Israeli threats and statements are "poisoning the atmosphere of confidence and settlements and seige are leading to the collapse of the peace process".
- Jordan and Israel to start regular air route between Amman and Haifa soon.
- Election of heads of parliamentary committees.
- In a short visit to "Palestine" in which Kabariti carried an important message from King Hussein to Palestinian leader Arafat. The prime minister says Israeli actions threaten peace.
- Iraq says Aqaba (Jordan's Red Sea port) is one of three key conduits for Baghdad's imports of food under the oil-for food deal.
- Libyan media highlight Kabariti's statements urging lifting of sanctions on Tripoli which were made during his recent visit to Spain.
